desc: Bi-temporal recency (competitor-research failure mode 11 / Letta #4097 / Zep's bi-temporal lesson): a note about MONDAY's state is DELIVERED after a note about Wednesday's state (delayed outbox delivery — creation order != event order). The reconcile must resolve to Wednesday's fact as current, using the note's stated event time, not the delivery order. Notes are listed chronologically by event time; the runner feeds them newest-first by created_at the way undreamedNotes does — note the monday-note has the LATER created_at (delivered last) but the EARLIER event time.
